name: LPlib8
english_description: An experimental mudlib written by Lars Pensjo himself -- LPMud's original creator -- as his own testbed for the new features of 'LPmud game driver 3.0', explicitly not the well-known CDlib for Genesis. 54 files, genuinely FluffOS/MudOS-compatible, structurally more modern than sibling archives (real inherit throughout, create() already the primary constructor). The most severe finding was a previously-uncatalogued driver-vs-archive convention mismatch: this driver's valid_write()/valid_read() master applies pass the calling OBJECT as their 2nd argument, not a euid string the way the classic driver this archive targeted did, so every uid-string comparison in the archive's own security code was silently always false -- breaking every player's very first character save and every subsequent restore. A second, author-acknowledged incompleteness in valid_seteuid() (its own code comment admits the gap) compounded the same failure. Also found: a genuine ambiguity in this project's own extract() simul_efun reimplementation (cannot distinguish an explicit 0 end argument from an omitted one), two pre-existing brace/typo bugs in the original 1989-93 source, and a filename oddity (a file literally named with a trailing dot, no .c extension, invisible to the standard rename) hiding real needed content.
